function.name: list_files
function.description: List files and directories in the current working directory or specified path

path.description: Path to list files from. Defaults to current directory if not specified.

show_hidden.description: Whether to show hidden files (starting with .)

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file

file_path.description: Path to the file to read

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to read. If not specified, reads entire file.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Execute a shell command in the current directory

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file, creating it if it doesn't exist or overwriting if it does

file_path.description: Path to the file to write

content.description: Content to write to the file

append.description: Whether to append to file instead of overwriting

function.name: create_directory
function.description: Create a directory, including parent directories if they don't exist

dir_path.description: Path to the directory to create

recursive.description: Whether to create parent directories if they don't exist
